caption: The image depicts a rectangular textile artwork mounted on a neutral-colored sheet. The textile consists of three borders: an outer wide border in reddish-brown, a narrower inner border in golden-yellow, and a central panel in a pale beige or off-white shade. Within the central panel is a figure of a man, constructed with colored textile patches. The man is shown standing, facing to the left, with his left hand on his hip and his right arm slightly raised. He wears a reddish-brown hat, a blue-gray jacket, matching trousers with a red-brown stripe and belt, tall reddish-brown boots, and gloves. His face is white, and black lines indicate his facial features and hair. The lower part of the central panel features several rows of black patterned lines, representing the ground or floor. The textile edges are uneven, and the composition is centered within the background sheet.
title: Pillow Top Insert
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
